# A firefly (generated by make_env.py), origin at its glow.
new
material new Glow --base-color 0.988 1.0 0.753 --no-slot
material new Head --base-color 0.933 0.612 0.365 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Glow --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.095 --location 0 0 0
material assign Glow
add mesh ico-sphere --name Head --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.06 --location 0 -0.11 0.03
material assign Head
select all
shade flat
export firefly.glb
